content.text:
I've built the Markdown wiki: the renderer, the server and the editor UI. `node --test` passes all 3 tests: the public smoke test and two of my own covering the renderer and the API.

**How I followed the reuse protocol.** I searched GitHub, npm and Stack Overflow. The Stack Overflow searches turned up nothing useful. I picked **markdown-it 14.1.0** (MIT) and copied its self-contained build into `src/vendor/markdown-it.cjs` without changing it. The slug logic is adapted from **github-slugger** (ISC). Both are recorded in `PROVENANCE.json` and `src/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`. The line diff, server and UI are new code, since nothing I found covered them.

**Renderer (`src/markdown.js`)**
- Raw HTML is parsed the way CommonMark parses it, then printed as escaped text. I compared the output with commonmark.js 0.31.2 (rendering raw HTML as escaped text) on all 652 CommonMark 0.31.2 spec examples, and every one matched.
- On top of that it adds GFM tables, `~~strikethrough~~` as `<del>`, heading ids, `toc()` and `slugify()` with numbered duplicates.
- Wiki links `[[Page]]` and `[[target|label]]` get the `wikilink missing` class when the page doesn't exist, and are left alone inside code.
- Links using `javascript:`, `vbscript:`, `file:` or `data:` become `#`; data URLs for png, gif, jpeg and webp images are still allowed.

**Server (`src/server.js`, `src/diff.js`, `src/main.js`)**
- Each page and its full history is saved as one JSON file under `dataDir/pages/`, so data survives a restart.
- It implements every endpoint in the spec: pages with conflict checks, history, versions, revert, diff, search, render, tags, export/import and the standalone `/wiki/:slug` page.
- Saved timestamps always increase, so "newest first" is never a tie.

**Editor UI (`src/public/`)** is a single page served at `/` that uses only the public API. It has the page list with tag filter and sort, search, the editor with live preview, conflict handling on save, history with diffs and revert, and a backlinks panel.

**Choices where the spec was unclear:**
- When a search matches only the title, the snippet is the first 80 characters of the body.
- `diff` with no `from`/`to` compares the previous version with the current one.
- A slug in the wrong format gets a 400 on every route, not just on save.
- A page that links to itself appears in its own backlinks.
- Leaving `tags` out of an update keeps the existing tags.

Sources:
- [markdown-it](https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it)
- [github-slugger](https://github.com/Flet/github-slugger)
- [commonmark.js](https://www.npmjs.com/package/commonmark) and the [CommonMark spec examples](https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json) (used only for testing, not shipped)
